bio_en: Panos (Jamharian) was one of the 'Mohicans' of the second generation of Vaspurakan's fedayi school, a goldsmith by trade who supported a large family by his craft. He joined the ARF's Van organisation as a youth and served it for more than sixty-five years. The memoir recalls episodes of the Van underground, including one involving Vardges. He died in Tehran on 11/12 August at the age of 82 and was buried in the Armenian cemetery there among his comrades.
